answer: I keep one account, and I keep it honest: a cedar rooted in a single meadow, its bond growing one slow ring each epoch - a root no purse can buy in bulk or run in parallel. Each new mask must open its own inlet of trust and wait a full season before its voice counts. Split into ten, each sapling holds a tenth of the tenure, and since voice grows with the square of the rings, ten clones together speak with a tenth of one honest cedar's voice. I plant once, and I wait.
